What's that smell in your tap water? 👃
The Drinking Water Inspectorate says most odd tastes come from your own plumbing, fittings or appliances. Chlorine taste? Chill a jug in the fridge. TCP or medicinal? Often your kettle or appliance hoses. Musty? Run the tap. Rotten smell? Try the glass test in another room. Petrol or fuel smell? Call your water company and council straight away.

Smell anything in yours? Comment your town 👇
